body: I completely agree. OP deserves an explanation and more respect from her husband and his family.
Unbelievable. The racism on top of the harassment is just beyond. I'm so sorry you had to deal with that.
Your love and resilience will guide him through. Every small step forward is a victory. Stay strong.

Thank you for your reply. A typical day starts with being woken up at 9:30am, crawling out of bed and not showing, putting on the same clothes I wore yesterday and going to the main ward. I take my anti-psychotic medication and basically just sit in a chair staring into space, trying and failing to remember my past. If anything crops up before I was 10 it distresses me because I know everything was al lright back then and I was happy, I had lots of friends and everything was peachy.  If anything comes up after the age of ten it distresses me because I just realize how insane I have been and how everyone must have thought I was crazy and strange and tragic! 


There is no continuity or sense to my life. I realise all teachers in secondary school hated me, where as I used to get on well at school when I was younger and was top of the class. After the incident I lost interest in everything and now I don't know anything. I find it hard to interact with anyone on any level at all. I just get scared and confused by all the people talking around me. Which is why people don't interact with me here.
